units.source_text: 一路行去，紫姬的面影常在眼前。

en.t: All along the way, the image of Lady Murasaki remained constantly before his eyes.

units.source_text: 终于怀着离愁乘上了行舟。

en.t: At last, carrying the sorrow of parting in his heart, he boarded the boat.

units.source_text: 暮春日子甚长，是日又值顺风，申时许已到达须磨浦。

en.t: The days were very long in late spring, and on that day a favorable wind was blowing, so by about the hour of the Monkey he had already reached the shore of Suma.

units.source_text: 旅途虽甚短暂，但因素无经验，觉得又是可悲，又是可喜，颇有新奇之感。

en.t: Although the journey was very short, because he had never experienced such a thing before, it seemed both sorrowful and pleasing, and felt quite strange and new.

units.source_text: 途中有一个地方，名叫大江殿，其地异常荒凉，遗址上只剩几株松树。

en.t: On the way there was a place called Oe-dono; it was extraordinarily desolate, and only a few pine trees remained on the ruins.
